title: Attention Is All You Need

depth_recommendation.reason: Foundational architecture behind most modern language models; worth mastering if you work in ML or NLP.

pack_notes: Built from arXiv v7 (2 Aug 2023). The paper appeared at NIPS 2017 (p. 1 footer), so it is peer-reviewed, not only a preprint.
Depth defaulted to 'use' with no background assumed, because none was given.
PDF page index and printed page numbers match on every numbered page (2-15); page 1 has no printed number. No printed_page fields are needed.
Mismatch in the paper: the abstract (p. 1) and Table 2 (p. 8) give 41.8 BLEU for EN-FR, but the text of Sec. 6.1 (p. 8) says 41.0. Claims use the table value and are marked medium confidence.
Mismatch in the paper: Table 3 lists dropout 0.3 for the big model, while Sec. 6.1 says the EN-FR big model used 0.1.
Figures 1 and 2 (pp. 3-4) are images. Their content is described here from the captions and Sec. 3 text; the pages will be rendered and inspected before any redraw in Round 4.
Appendix Figures 3-5 (pp. 13-15) are attention heat-line images whose text extracts as scattered words. Only their captions are used.
Likely citation slip in the paper: Sec. 5.1 (p. 7) cites [3] for byte-pair encoding, but [3] is Britz et al.; byte-pair encoding is [31]. refs.json r3 is marked medium confidence.
Reference links come from arXiv IDs printed in the reference list; their titles were matched against the arXiv API in this chat, but link_verified stays false until you open them.

Unlock choices: v03 shows the Table 2 numbers at triage_done, as the catalog asks; that is after the pass 1 prediction q3 is made. v09 (limits) is locked to debrief instead of pass4, because it would give away the answer to q12.
The predict-first pair v20/v20b uses Table 3 rows (A) (number of heads), not Fig. 1, because v02 already shows Fig. 1 at triage_done.

Original Figures 1 and 2 are included as PNGs in visuals/original/ (type 'original_figure', with a 'credit' field). Page 1 of the paper grants permission to reproduce its tables and figures for scholarly work with attribution. These two fields are additions to the base schema; the bundled study app accepts them.
lessons.json (10 lessons, 32 steps, Simple and Full levels) is an addition to the base prompt: it powers the app's Read mode. See paper-study-app/PROMPT-ADDENDUM.md.
Sections 1-7 run 10 pages, so the whole paper is covered; no appendix permission needed.
